messages:
morgan: Kicking off a hotpatch deploy to prod in 10m. Change window 11:00-11:30 PT. Main ask: confirm backout/runbook and pins before we flip.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Deploy pipeline started for hotpatch/hf-2026. Canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345
alex: quick Q — what's our rollback trigger? latency spike + error rate >2%? or stricter for this path?
riya: Rollback criteria: 1) 5m error rate >1.5% OR 2) p95 latency >600ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR 3) user-facing failure in /v1/generation. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/hotpatch-lifeboat
samir: Linking the succinct unwind steps I use in oncall: 1) pin model to release v2.14.1 2) disable canary routing 3) scale down hotpatch pool 4) trigger rollback job `scripts/rollback_hotpatch.sh --tag v2.14.1`
jamie: +1. Where is the stateful cache flush step? We must clear KV cache to avoid serving mixed kvs after rollback.
riya: Good call — step 2.5 is `curl -X POST https://ops-api/kv/flush -H 'X-Env: prod'` (we only flush patch cache namespace). Added to runbook snippet.
morgan: Who owns the rollpin if we need to abort? nominating @alex for primary, @riya backup.
alex: I can take the rollpin. If I hit the pin/unpin script I will ping #eng-releases and @deploy-bot so automation can stop the ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 20% — monitoring metrics. Automated fallback wiring is enabled (fallback->v2.14.1).
samir: FYI command to force immediate fallback if needed: `deployctl fallbacks activate --target v2.14.1 --reason "hotpatch abort"` — needs release-admin perms.
jamie: If we fallback, will existing requests finish on hotpatch instance or drain? We should drain gracefully: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/hotpatch --grace-period=60` then pin. See runbook section "graceful-drain".
riya: Noted. Also added rollback checklist to the runbook with exact SLAs and PR template for postmortem: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/hotpatch-lifeboat#postmortem
morgan: OK executing. Canary -> 50% in 2m. Team watch channels: this thread + #eng-releases. Call if triggers hit.
alex: Ready. I've got the pin script on my laptop and ssh to prod gateway. Will execute if criteria met. :thumbsup:
riya: Monitoring dashboards pinned: Hotpatch-errors, Hotpatch-p95, Router-5xx. Alerts copied to this channel.
deploy-bot: Canary at 50% -> scheduled 100% in 5m unless aborted.
morgan: Thanks all. If anyone sees anything odd, post here and escalate to Pager if urgent.
